name: Google Gemini API
purpose: Cloud API for Google's Gemini models covering text, multimodal input, image and speech generation, transcription and live voice.
advantages: Official Python and JavaScript SDKs under Apache-2.0
limitations: Free-tier content may be used to improve Google products and read by human reviewers
Free-tier numeric limits not published in docs
Flagship models not on free tier

integration.notes: FastAPI: call the SDK from a server-side endpoint; keep the key out of client code.

restrictions: Per-project rate limits visible only in AI Studio
Prompts and responses may be used to improve products

pricing.notes: paid_starting_from = USD per 1M input tokens, Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite.

licence.name: Proprietary (Google API Terms + Gemini API Additional Terms); SDK Apache-2.0

verification.overall_notes: Verified against official Google AI developer documentation.
